verdict.rationale: Bevy's own site lists real-time 2D rendering as a headline feature next to its 3D renderer. It ships a 2D 'breakout' example, and a community developer describes working with sprites, so 2D is not merely an afterthought. However, the evidence never mentions tilemaps or 2D physics, which are two of the three pillars of the story. Missing for 10: tilemap support, 2D physics, in-depth 2D/sprite documentation, independent corroboration that 2D is first-class.
